description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ConfigurationInterface' within the namespace 'Aws\ClientSideMonitoring'. It provides method signatures for accessing client-side monitoring configuration options such as 'enabled', 'client ID', 'host', 'port', and a method to return the configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface defining configuration access methods for client-side monitoring in AWS SDK.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether or not client-side monitoring is enabled.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the Client ID, if available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
